title: QR Menu Payment
scenario: A restaurant QR menu abroad opens a payment page before showing prices.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.C: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: QR Menu Payment: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Confirm with staff before paying through QR codes.
